description: Unsigned transactions for a pair trade: buy and lend the long stock in your name (it earns lending fees while held), then short the other, approvals first. Priced now; simulated from the wallet in order.

deposit.description: USDG held against the short beyond the sale (optional), in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

long.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

long_amount.description: Long stock to buy, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

short.description: A stock on Borro by its ticker, like NVDA or AAPL (markets lists every one)

short_amount.description: Stock to short, in whole units as a decimal string, like "1.5"

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: open_pair
title: Prepare: open a pair
